name: Heavy agent sandbox
audit_basis: v4.3.0: regenerated by tools/build_evidence.py from evidence/traceability.json. Reference-scope implementation raises MISSING to PARTIAL only; no control becomes EVIDENCED without the production path and independent review (checklist GATE-01/GATE-03).

status_definitions.EVIDENCED: Repository contains direct documentation or executable evidence sufficient for the narrow checklist statement at repository/reference-model scope.
status_definitions.PARTIAL: Some direct evidence exists, but production scope, completeness, integration, durability, approval, or verification is missing.
status_definitions.MISSING: No substantive repository evidence implements or verifies the checklist requirement.

controls.requirement: Define the exact production responsibility of Heavy agent sandbox.
controls.assessment: Responsibility is explicitly defined.

controls.requirement: Document what Heavy agent sandbox owns and explicitly does not own.
controls.assessment: Owned and not-owned responsibilities are explicitly separated.

controls.requirement: Identify upstream, downstream, and peer dependencies of Heavy agent sandbox.
controls.assessment: Upstream/downstream dependencies are enumerated.

controls.requirement: Define the authoritative source of truth used by Heavy agent sandbox.
controls.assessment: Clean base snapshot is named as source of truth.

controls.requirement: Document assumptions Heavy agent sandbox makes about nodes, runtimes, networks, storage, and control planes.
controls.assessment: Failure/trust assumptions are documented.

controls.requirement: Define tenant, environment, site, and workload boundaries relevant to Heavy agent sandbox.
controls.assessment: Tenant, environment, site, and workload boundaries are documented.

controls.requirement: Separate mandatory Heavy agent sandbox capabilities from optional optimizations.
controls.assessment: Mandatory and optional capabilities are separated.

controls.requirement: Document unsupported deployment patterns and non-goals for Heavy agent sandbox.
controls.assessment: Non-goals are documented.

controls.requirement: Assign an accountable owner and escalation path for Heavy agent sandbox.
controls.assessment: Accountable owner, on-call/escalation path, and authority model are absent.

controls.requirement: Approve an architecture decision record for Heavy agent sandbox, its technologies (Firecracker microVM), and its function (Stateful execution, filesystem access, and deeper OS integration).
controls.assessment: ADR exists only as Proposed; no accountable organizational approval record is present.

controls.requirement: Translate the source function of Heavy agent sandbox — Stateful execution, filesystem access, and deeper OS integration — into testable SHALL-level requirements.
controls.assessment: Mandatory behavior exists, but there is no complete SHALL-level requirements specification with acceptance criteria.

controls.requirement: Define functional requirements for Heavy agent sandbox across cloud, datacenter, near-edge, and far-edge contexts where applicable.
controls.assessment: No environment-specific functional requirements for cloud, datacenter, near-edge, or far-edge deployments.

controls.requirement: Define non-functional requirements for latency, availability, durability, consistency, isolation, or determinism as applicable.
controls.assessment: Three SLOs are declared, but availability/durability/consistency/determinism objectives are not comprehensively specified.

controls.requirement: Define success, partial success, degraded operation, retryable failure, and terminal failure semantics for Heavy agent sandbox.
controls.assessment: Reference exceptions and active/closed behavior exist, but success/partial/degraded/retryable/terminal semantics are not comprehensively modeled.

controls.requirement: Define lifecycle states and legal state transitions managed or exposed by Heavy agent sandbox.
controls.assessment: Reference lifecycle has ACTIVE/CLOSED only; production create/starting/ready/draining/failed/reaping transitions are absent.

controls.requirement: Define versioning and backward-compatibility requirements for Heavy agent sandbox.
controls.assessment: No supported-version/backward-compatibility policy for INV-71 or its external interfaces.

controls.requirement: Define capacity ceilings, quotas, and fairness semantics relevant to Heavy agent sandbox.
controls.assessment: Disk/file limits exist in the reference model; CPU, memory, pids, I/O, network, fairness, and fleet ceilings are absent.

controls.requirement: Define behavior when network connectivity is intermittent or absent.
controls.assessment: No intermittent/offline-network behavior or recovery semantics.

controls.requirement: Define precedence rules when Heavy agent sandbox requirements conflict with security, residency, SLO, or cost constraints.
controls.assessment: No precedence policy for conflicts among security, residency, SLO, and cost constraints.

controls.requirement: Maintain a requirements traceability matrix from each Heavy agent sandbox requirement to implementation and verification evidence.
controls.assessment: A control-status matrix exists, but there is no full requirement-to-production-implementation-to-verification traceability matrix.

controls.requirement: Enumerate every API, WIT contract, RPC, event, file, device, hypervisor, or control-plane boundary exposed by Heavy agent sandbox.
controls.assessment: Three logical record interfaces are named; hypervisor, image, device, filesystem, network, identity, and control-plane boundaries are not fully enumerated.

controls.requirement: Use versioned typed schemas for all externally visible Heavy agent sandbox contracts.
controls.assessment: Versioned JSON Schemas exist for three logical records, but the complete external API/transport contract is not defined.

controls.requirement: Define authentication requirements at each Heavy agent sandbox boundary.
controls.assessment: No authentication design for session, egress, teardown, hypervisor, image, node, or control-plane boundaries.

controls.requirement: Define authorization and explicit capability requirements at each Heavy agent sandbox boundary.
controls.assessment: Exact-host egress authorization exists; capabilities and authorization at every production boundary are not defined.

controls.requirement: Define timeout, cancellation, retry, idempotency, and backpressure semantics for Heavy agent sandbox.
controls.assessment: No complete timeout, cancellation, retry, idempotency, or backpressure semantics.

controls.requirement: Define structured failure codes and machine-readable error details for Heavy agent sandbox.
controls.assessment: Typed Python exceptions exist locally, but no stable external machine-readable error-code contract exists.

controls.requirement: Define compatibility behavior when peers use different supported versions.
controls.assessment: No mixed-version peer compatibility behavior.

controls.requirement: Document payload, concurrency, queue, connection, or resource limits at Heavy agent sandbox interfaces.
controls.assessment: Disk/file/history limits exist; payload, connection, concurrency, CPU, memory, process, I/O, and queue limits are incomplete.

controls.requirement: Provide reference examples and conformance fixtures for Heavy agent sandbox.
controls.assessment: Tests and schemas provide examples, but no formal adjacent-layer conformance fixture bundle exists.

controls.requirement: Create automated integration tests proving Heavy agent sandbox interoperates with adjacent architectural layers.
controls.assessment: No automated integration tests with adjacent architectural layers.

controls.requirement: Select and pin approved implementations, versions, or specifications for Heavy agent sandbox: Firecracker microVM.
controls.assessment: No pinned Firecracker, kernel, jailer, rootfs/base-image, or snapshot format versions.

controls.requirement: Separate immutable artifacts from mutable configuration and state for Heavy agent sandbox.
controls.assessment: Immutable base semantics are modeled, but no production artifact/configuration/state layout or signed immutable image set exists.

controls.requirement: Define declarative configuration and secure defaults for Heavy agent sandbox.
controls.assessment: No declarative production configuration format with secure defaults.

controls.requirement: Validate configuration before activation and fail closed on security-critical errors.
controls.assessment: Reference inputs fail closed, but production configuration validation/activation is not implemented.

controls.requirement: Support site- and environment-specific configuration without rebuilding immutable artifacts.
controls.assessment: No site/environment overlay configuration mechanism independent of immutable artifacts.

controls.requirement: Record configuration provenance, version, author, and activation time.
controls.assessment: No configuration provenance/author/version/activation-time record.

controls.requirement: Apply atomic or transactional configuration updates where partial application is unsafe.
controls.assessment: Reference filesystem updates are copy-then-commit under a lock; production configuration transactions are absent.

controls.requirement: Define automatic and operator-driven rollback for failed Heavy agent sandbox changes.
controls.assessment: Rollback is described conceptually around previous evidence/snapshots; no deployable automatic/operator rollback mechanism exists.

controls.requirement: Keep credentials and secret material out of ordinary Heavy agent sandbox configuration and diagnostics.
controls.assessment: No credentials are embedded in ordinary repo configuration, but a production secret injection/redaction mechanism is absent.

controls.requirement: Provide a deterministic bootstrap path from an empty node/environment to healthy Heavy agent sandbox operation.
controls.assessment: Local test/audit bootstrap is deterministic, but empty-node-to-production-health bootstrap is not implemented.

controls.requirement: Threat-model Heavy agent sandbox against malicious tenants, compromised workloads, hostile inputs, supply-chain compromise, and control-plane abuse.
controls.assessment: Threat model covers malicious workloads, compromised content/dependencies, supply chain, control-plane abuse, resource exhaustion, escape, replay/spoofing, side channels, and residual data.

controls.requirement: Apply least privilege to every identity and capability used by Heavy agent sandbox.
controls.assessment: Reference privileges are narrow for paths/egress; production host identities, devices, syscalls, mounts, and control-plane permissions are not defined.

controls.requirement: Eliminate ambient filesystem, network, device, kernel, and secret authority wherever Heavy agent sandbox permits.
controls.assessment: Path and egress authority are constrained in the model; ambient kernel/device/secret/filesystem authority is not eliminated by a production boundary.

controls.requirement: Authenticate nodes, peers, artifacts, providers, and control-plane actors before trust is granted.
controls.assessment: No node/peer/artifact/provider/control-plane authentication or attestation implementation.

controls.requirement: Verify signatures, digests, provenance, and approved versions for executable or policy artifacts consumed by Heavy agent sandbox.
controls.assessment: No signature, digest, provenance, SBOM, or approved-version verification pipeline for executable/policy artifacts.

controls.requirement: Enforce tenant/workload isolation across Heavy agent sandbox execution, memory, state, network, and device boundaries as applicable.
controls.assessment: Cross-session clean-start semantics are tested in memory; real VM memory/state/network/device isolation evidence is absent.

controls.requirement: Encrypt sensitive Heavy agent sandbox data in transit and at rest with managed key rotation.
controls.assessment: No in-transit/at-rest encryption design with managed key rotation.

controls.requirement: Define safe behavior when identity, attestation, policy, key, or time services are unavailable.
controls.assessment: No fail-closed/degraded policy for identity, attestation, policy, key, or time service outages.

controls.requirement: Emit tamper-evident audit events for security-sensitive Heavy agent sandbox operations.
controls.assessment: Reference audit events are hash chained and tamper-detecting in process; they are unsigned, non-durable, and not externally anchored.

controls.requirement: Run adversarial tests for privilege escalation, injection, replay, spoofing, escape, side channels, and resource exhaustion.
controls.assessment: Traversal, forbidden egress, quotas, lifecycle misuse, and audit tampering are tested; escape, injection, replay, spoofing, side-channel, and hypervisor adversarial tests are absent.

controls.requirement: Enumerate component, process, VM, node, site, network, provider, dependency, and control-plane failures affecting Heavy agent sandbox.
controls.assessment: Several failures are listed, but there is no exhaustive component/process/VM/node/site/provider/control-plane failure matrix.

controls.requirement: Define automated health and stall detection thresholds for Heavy agent sandbox.
controls.assessment: No automated health/stall detection thresholds.

controls.requirement: Implement bounded retry with backoff and jitter only where operations are safe to retry.
controls.assessment: No bounded retry/backoff/jitter implementation or retry-safety classification.

controls.requirement: Implement admission control, load shedding, or circuit breaking to prevent Heavy agent sandbox failure cascades.
controls.assessment: No admission control, load shedding, or circuit breaker.

controls.requirement: Define failover behavior without violating isolation, residency, or consistency requirements.
controls.assessment: No failover design constrained by isolation/residency/consistency.

controls.requirement: Provide degraded operation when noncritical dependencies are unavailable.
controls.assessment: No explicit degraded-mode behavior for noncritical dependency loss.

controls.requirement: Define crash-consistency, restart, resume, or replay semantics for mutable Heavy agent sandbox state.
controls.assessment: Clean re-instantiation and closed-state semantics exist; crash consistency, restart/resume, replay, and mutable production state semantics are absent.

controls.requirement: Protect against split-brain, duplicate ownership, stale controllers, or duplicate execution where relevant.
controls.assessment: No split-brain, duplicate ownership, stale-controller, or duplicate-execution protection.

controls.requirement: Provide quarantine, freeze, disable, or isolation controls for unsafe Heavy agent sandbox behavior.
controls.assessment: Teardown closes a reference session; operator quarantine/freeze/disable controls for production workloads are absent.

controls.requirement: Run fault-injection tests proving Heavy agent sandbox recovery against documented objectives.
controls.assessment: No fault-injection recovery test suite.

controls.requirement: Establish reproducible baselines for Heavy agent sandbox latency, throughput, startup, CPU, memory, storage, network, and power overhead.
controls.assessment: No reproducible latency/throughput/startup/CPU/memory/storage/network/power baselines.

controls.requirement: Define p50, p95, p99, and worst-case performance thresholds for Heavy agent sandbox.
controls.assessment: A p99 startup target is present; p50/p95/worst-case targets across CPU/memory/storage/network are absent.

controls.requirement: Measure Heavy agent sandbox under steady load, burst load, overload, scale-out, scale-in, and recovery.
controls.assessment: No steady/burst/overload/scale-out/scale-in/recovery performance test suite.

controls.requirement: Measure per-workload and per-tenant overhead introduced by Heavy agent sandbox.
controls.assessment: No per-workload/per-tenant overhead measurements.

controls.requirement: Identify avoidable serialization, copies, context switches, network hops, duplicated images, or duplicated state in Heavy agent sandbox.
controls.assessment: No profiling evidence for copies, serialization, context switches, hops, duplicated images, or duplicated state.

controls.requirement: Apply locality, caching, direct composition, batching, zero-copy, or kernel-bypass optimizations where semantics permit.
controls.assessment: No measured/justified locality, caching, batching, zero-copy, direct-composition, or kernel-bypass optimization plan.

controls.requirement: Bound memory growth, queue depth, buffer size, concurrency, and resource fan-out.
controls.assessment: Disk/file/history growth is bounded; production memory, queues, buffers, concurrency, process count, and resource fan-out are not comprehensively bounded.

controls.requirement: Measure power and thermal impact on constrained edge nodes where relevant.
controls.assessment: No power/thermal measurements for constrained edge nodes.

controls.requirement: Define capacity models and saturation signals that predict when Heavy agent sandbox needs more resources.
controls.assessment: No capacity model or saturation signals tied to scaling decisions.

controls.requirement: Block releases that regress approved Heavy agent sandbox startup, density, throughput, or tail-latency thresholds.
controls.assessment: No automated release gate for startup/density/throughput/tail-latency regressions.

controls.requirement: Expose Heavy agent sandbox health, readiness, version, configuration, dependency status, and active capability set.
controls.assessment: Version and session state exist locally; there is no production health/readiness/config/dependency/capability status endpoint.

controls.requirement: Emit structured metrics for rate, errors, latency, saturation, backlog, and resource use.
controls.assessment: Metric names are declared, but no structured metrics emitter/exporter is implemented.

controls.requirement: Emit structured logs with stable node, tenant, workload, component, and operation identifiers.
controls.assessment: Structured reference audit events exist but lack production node/tenant/workload correlation and durable log export.

controls.requirement: Propagate trace context across all relevant Heavy agent sandbox boundaries.
controls.assessment: No distributed trace-context propagation.

controls.requirement: Expose high-cardinality diagnostic detail safely without leaking tenant or secret data.
controls.assessment: No safe high-cardinality diagnostic mechanism with tenant/secret redaction controls.

controls.requirement: Record the reason for every automated decision made by Heavy agent sandbox.
controls.assessment: Reference decisions carry reason text for several operations; not every automated production decision is covered.

controls.requirement: Provide an operator-readable explain view linking decisions to input state, policies, topology, and constraints.
controls.assessment: No operator explain view tying decisions to policy/input/topology/constraints.

controls.requirement: Correlate Heavy agent sandbox events with application release lineage and the live infrastructure graph.
controls.assessment: No correlation with application release lineage or live infrastructure graph.

controls.requirement: Define telemetry retention, sampling, privacy, and export policy.
controls.assessment: No telemetry retention, sampling, privacy, or export policy.

controls.requirement: Create dashboards and alerts distinguishing ordinary load, degradation, policy rejection, dependency failure, attack, and software defect.
controls.assessment: No dashboards/alerts separating load, degradation, policy rejection, dependency failure, attack, and defects.

controls.requirement: Create unit tests for deterministic Heavy agent sandbox logic and state transitions.
controls.assessment: Dependency-free deterministic unit tests exercise snapshot, path, egress, quotas, teardown, lifecycle, and audit-chain behavior.

controls.requirement: Create contract tests for every public Heavy agent sandbox interface.
controls.assessment: Record schemas and unit behavior tests exist; transport/API contract tests for every public interface are absent.

controls.requirement: Create integration tests with every supported adjacent layer and execution tier.
controls.assessment: No production integration tests across every supported adjacent layer/execution tier.

controls.requirement: Create compatibility tests across supported CPU architectures, runtimes, hypervisors, providers, and protocol versions relevant to Heavy agent sandbox.
controls.assessment: No compatibility test matrix across architectures, hypervisors, runtimes, providers, or protocol versions.

controls.requirement: Fuzz parsers, schemas, protocol handlers, WIT/RPC boundaries, or untrusted inputs handled by Heavy agent sandbox.
controls.assessment: No fuzzing for schemas, parsers, protocol handlers, control-plane inputs, or other untrusted inputs.

controls.requirement: Create concurrency and race-condition tests for shared/distributed Heavy agent sandbox state.
controls.assessment: No concurrency/race-condition tests for shared/distributed production state.

controls.requirement: Create security tests derived directly from the Heavy agent sandbox threat model.
controls.assessment: Some tests derive from threats, but the threat-model test suite is incomplete and does not exercise a real isolation boundary.

controls.requirement: Create benchmark, soak, burst, and fleet-scale tests appropriate to Heavy agent sandbox.
controls.assessment: No benchmark, soak, burst, or fleet-scale test harness.

controls.requirement: Create disaster, partition, reconnect, and degraded-control-plane tests.
controls.assessment: No disaster/partition/reconnect/degraded-control-plane tests.

controls.requirement: Require machine-readable acceptance evidence before certifying a Heavy agent sandbox release for production.
controls.assessment: Machine-readable audit evidence exists, but it is not a signed release acceptance/gate artifact for a production implementation.

controls.requirement: Define production SLOs, error budgets, and support commitments for Heavy agent sandbox.
controls.assessment: SLOs and error-budget statements exist; support commitments and operational measurement evidence are absent.

controls.requirement: Define canary, staged rollout, rollback, and emergency-disable procedures for Heavy agent sandbox.
controls.assessment: Rollback/emergency-disable concepts are described; canary/staged rollout implementation and tested rollback are absent.

controls.requirement: Maintain a supported-version compatibility matrix for Heavy agent sandbox and adjacent dependencies.
controls.assessment: No supported-version compatibility matrix for adjacent dependencies.

controls.requirement: Define patching, vulnerability response, and end-of-life SLAs for Heavy agent sandbox.
controls.assessment: No patching, vulnerability-response, or end-of-life SLA.

controls.requirement: Provide backup, restore, migration, or reconstruction procedures for Heavy agent sandbox state where applicable.
controls.assessment: Clean-snapshot reconstruction is conceptual; production image/snapshot backup, restore, migration, and validation procedures are absent.

controls.requirement: Create day-0 bootstrap, day-1 deployment, and day-2 operation runbooks.
controls.assessment: Day-0/day-1/day-2 guidance exists only at a high level and is not an executable production runbook.

controls.requirement: Define incident severity, paging, escalation, containment, and recovery procedures.
controls.assessment: No incident severity, paging, escalation, containment, or recovery procedure.

controls.requirement: Perform recurring access, policy, dependency, configuration, and architecture reviews.
controls.assessment: No recurring access/policy/dependency/configuration/architecture review process.

controls.requirement: Track exceptions, waivers, technical debt, and deprecated behaviors with owners and expiry dates.
controls.assessment: No exception/waiver/technical-debt/deprecation register with owners and expiry dates.

controls.requirement: Require a formal production exit gate confirming architecture, requirements, interfaces, implementation, security, resilience, performance, observability, testing, rollback, and ownership readiness.
controls.assessment: No formal production exit gate aggregating architecture through ownership readiness evidence.
